Myth: Sugar directly causes cavities.

Fact: Sugar itself doesn't cause cavities — bacteria do! When you eat sugary foods, oral bacteria feed on the sugar and produce acid as a byproduct. This acid is what erodes your enamel and creates cavities over time.
So while cutting back on sugar helps, the real key is removing the bacteria and acid through regular brushing, flossing, and dental check-ups!
✅ Brush twice daily

✅ Visit your dentist every 6 months

Transform Your Smile with Precision: Full Quadrant Dental Implant Rehabilitation 🦷✨
Dealing with a failing dental bridge, persistent infections, or missing teeth can take a toll on your health and confidence. At Broadway Smiles Dental Care, we specialize in turning complex dental challenges into healthy, functional, and beautiful smiles using advanced implant technology.

Here is a look behind the scenes of a recent complete quadrant rehabilitation case at our clinic:

🔹 The Clinical Challenge
The patient presented with a failing bridge, periapical granulomas (chronic infections), and active inflammation. Step one was safely resolving the infection to secure a healthy foundation.

🔹 Building a Strong Foundation
Once the area was completely healed, we placed dental implants. If you look at the clinical photos, you will notice the thick, healthy soft tissue architecture around the site—this robust gum tissue is absolutely essential for the long-term success and stability of the implant.

🔹 The Digital Edge
No messy, uncomfortable traditional molds were used for this treatment. We captured the patient's anatomy with a high-precision Digital Intraoral Scanner and utilized 3D-printed resin models to ensure 100% accuracy and a perfect fit.

🔹 The Final Result
We delivered final, custom screw-retained implant crowns. They are perfectly aligned, highly biocompatible, and structurally built to last a lifetime.

A 10mm gap? Challenge accepted. 👊✨

Closing a massive 1 cm (10mm) midline diastema is one of the ultimate tests in cosmetic dentistry. A quick fix just wouldn't cut it here. If we only used veneers, the front teeth would look unnaturally wide. If we only used braces, we’d compromise the patient's bite and profile.

2️⃣ Prostho Finish: Once the teeth were perfectly placed, we used ultra-conservative, custom ceramic restorations to close the remaining spaces with flawless, natural proportions.

The Hidden Risks of “DIY” Aligners: What Mumbai Patients Need to Know Before Buying Online

Are mail-order aligners worth the risk? While the "doorstep delivery" model is trending in Mumbai, treating orthodontics as a product rather than a medical procedure is leading to a rise in irreversible dental damage.

As a specialist orthodontic practice in Dadar , we are seeing an increase in patients seeking "rescue treatment" after DIY kits failed. Here is the clinical truth:

🔬 Orthodontics is Biology, Not Just Plastic
Moving teeth involves controlled bone remodeling. Without a physical evaluation of your bone density and periodontal health, tooth movement can become unpredictable and harmful.

🩻 The Danger of "Working Blind" (No X-rays)
Most DIY systems skip OPG (Panoramic X-rays) and CBCT scans. In our Mumbai clinics, we use these to detect:

Hidden impacted teeth

Shortened roots (Root Resorption)

Underlying bone loss
Moving teeth without this data is like driving in Mumbai monsoon traffic with a blindfold on—it’s a major safety risk.

⚠️ Common DIY Complications:
Root Damage: Without clinical monitoring, forces can be too heavy, causing roots to dissolve.

Bite Misalignment: Many mail-order systems leave you with a "posterior open bite," making it difficult to chew.

Gum Recession: Pushing teeth outside the "bone envelope" can lead to permanent gum loss.

📍 Don’t gamble with your smile. If you are in South Mumbai or the Western Suburbs, choose a diagnosis-driven approach.

A small fracture at the incisal edge can make a big difference to your smile and confidence. In this video, we’re showcasing a conservative ''direct composite restoration'' performed at our clinic—restoring both form and function in a single visit.

Using advanced adhesive dentistry and high-quality composite materials, we carefully rebuilt the tooth—layer by layer—to mimic natural enamel and dentin. The goal is always seamless integration, so the restoration blends invisibly with your existing tooth.

💡 Why composite restorations?
